name: A ladrang in pelog
about: Composed for this atlas in the manner of a Javanese court gending: a balungan (the skeletal melody the saron plays) in pelog, here on D, E flat, F, A and B flat, laid out in ladrang form, eight gatra of four beats to each gongan, the kenong closing every eight beats and the great gong the thirty-second. Two gongan, the second rising to the high register. Gamelan tunings are not those of the piano; these are the nearest notes.
